config.install_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /workspace/CTF_WP
bash tools/environment/setup.sh
config.start_skill: Use /workspace/CTF_WP as the existing checkout; each task is isolated, so do not create a worktree unless requested. Run bash tools/environment/setup.sh (68 tests and a temporary graph lifecycle check), then export PATH="/workspace/CTF_WP/bin:$PATH". To start the deployed Sapper local graph viewer, run `cd /workspace/CTF_WP && bash tools/environment/start-sapper.sh` in a persistent terminal/process. This preserves existing .sapper state, initializes the graph if missing, configures project-only Claude hooks, validates, then serves on loopback port 8765 (override SAPPER_VIEW_PORT if needed). Verify both the HTML page and its referenced /__sapper_graph__/<token>.json endpoint return the current graph. Processes do not survive snapshots; restart this command in each new instance. Read docs/environment.md for runtime/stop/log instructions and system background. This is local graph tracking/visualization; no agent or competition legion is automatically dispatched. Competition platform and model gateway credentials are not configured. Never commit .sapper, runtime logs, hook settings or secrets. Project-specific project-analysis and code-read skills are bundled under .agents/skills. Sapper user-facing status/validation defaults to Chinese; set SAPPER_LANG=en for English CLI feedback. Model templates require Chinese human-readable result fields, preserving JSON keys and IDs.
